title: Three consumers get the same results on a device as on the writer store in a context that composes both collections

provenance.note: The context composes the snapshots of the two fixture collections (CTX-CMP-1). No fixture object has a `logical_id`, so no root has a pin and the context has no binding skew (CTX-SKW-1, CTX-SKW-2). Each read and lock step comes from the scenario vectors of one collection, with the handles of that fixture. The last lock has the units of both collections, and its items are the union of their closures. The export and import items are the closure of both roots. Each device step expects the same items as the writer step (BUN-CLS-3, BUN-CLS-4).
